With a calibrated 40x23 noise fixture at 640x360/30, authenticated bitrate reduction/restoration and unauthorized rejection passed: H264/VP9 native 2000-to-500 kbps; AV1 native and VP9/AV1 helpers 2000-to-1000 kbps. Transition identity continuity observed for H264, AV1 and both helpers. Linux bitrate changes reinitialize with rollback; native VPx/AV1 use realtime CBR. Detailed 160x90 noise overshoots 500 kbps with independent FFmpeg as well; native AV1 at 500 kbps lost barcode fidelity in the 40x23 fixture, without an established root cause. Low-rate quality/overshoot, 720p60 and higher profiles, color/quality/cadence, timestamp/drift, failure rollback/recovery, custom option edge cases and OBS compatibility remain. VP8 backend is unqualified.
NVIDIA path requires working accessible driver. NVENC probe currently fails CUDA_ERROR_NO_DEVICE. Future hardware backends remain extensible; never claim unavailable devices qualified.
